name: Gap Spam
description: Flies the wave into a narrow gap between two blocks and spams through it. For botting gap levels.

gap-enabled.name: Enable
gap-enabled.description: Turn the gap assist on or off.

gap-max-size.name: Max gap size
gap-max-size.description: Gaps larger than this (in units) are ignored. The wave's block hitbox is about 10 units.

gap-half.name: Wave hitbox half size
gap-half.description: Half of the wave's block hitbox in units (5 = a 10x10 hitbox). Scaled automatically for mini wave.

gap-approach.name: Approach distance
gap-approach.description: How many units before the gap the mod starts steering the wave to its center.

gap-percent-on.name: Only in a percent range
gap-percent-on.description: Work only between the two percents below. Use it to show the mod where the gap section is.
